question: The average age of 31 students of a class is 34 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 35 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the Net Change Method for averages:

Age of new member = Old Average + (New total members × Increase in average)

⇒ Age of teacher = 34 + (32 × 1)

⇒ Age of teacher = 34 + 32 = 66

**∴ The correct answer is 66 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of 31 students = 34 years

Average age when teacher is included (32 people) = 35 years

**Formula Used:**

Total Age = Average Age × Number of People
